name: scroll-stopping-creative
title_zh: 前3秒定生死的广告创意生成器
tagline_zh: 刷到就划走的时代，它专产让人拇指停住的广告点子。不空谈创意，直接给你能拍的画面、能说的文案、能剪的节奏。
tagline_en: In a scroll-past world, it crafts ad ideas that freeze thumbs. No vague brainstorming—get shootable visuals.
desc_en: Create ad concepts that stop attention in the first 3 seconds. Trigger on "ad creative", "thumbstopper", "video ideas".
why_zh: 它把「注意力峰值」当工程参数算，每个概念都自带前3秒的钩子结构，不是灵感碰运气，是机制保证开场即抓人。
why_en: It treats attention spikes as engineering specs—every concept ships with a built-in 3-second hook structure, so grabbing viewers.
limit_zh: 只产出创意概念和分镜脚本，不含完整视频制作或投放策略。需要你自行拍摄剪辑；若产品本身无视觉冲击点，生成的概念会偏抽象。
limit_en: Outputs only concepts & shot lists—no full production or ad-buying strategy. You handle shooting/editing. For visually bland products, ideas skew.
title_en: Ad concepts that win in the first 3 seconds
